overview: Compiling a weekly report by hand means opening six tools and pasting numbers. We connect the tools you use, pull the figures you track, such as sales, ad spend, orders and sign-ups, and send a tidy report to your inbox or Slack at the same time every week. It shows the change from last week and highlights anything unusual in plain words.

faq: Which tools can it pull numbers from?
Shopify, WooCommerce, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Stripe, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, Klaviyo and Google Sheets are common. We confirm access for each before you order.
Will the numbers match what I see in each tool?
They should, within the way each tool counts. Tools often count orders or visits differently, so we state the definition for every figure and test against the tool itself.
Can different people get different reports?
Yes, in the Premium package. For instance, a short summary for the owner and a detailed one for the marketing lead, each on its own schedule.
Do I need a special reporting tool?
No. We can build it in Google Sheets or Looker Studio, sent by email as a PDF or link. Any subscription for a paid tool is billed to you, and we advise on the simplest option.
